items.title: Veteran Benefits Kit — the front door
items.use: Start here. Pick what's going on, answer one or two questions, and get your next step and who to contact.

items.title: Semester Pay Planner
items.use: Answer one question at a time; see what VA would pay each month for each stretch of your term, with the VA rule one tap away.

items.title: Which Benefit Am I On
items.use: Answer a few questions to find the benefit you have, what it pays, and who to ask. Points the way; does not decide.

items.title: Benefits Front-Desk Map
items.use: For whoever is at the desk: pick what the student brings up, answer a question or two, get the steps and who takes it. Office sheet, not the student handout.

restrictedScan.note: The package encodes and lists only these four addresses; the student sheet carries only the three student-facing ones. No repository path, brief, transcript, harness, ADR or Drive address appears anywhere in the package.
